about: One entry per value of the core that is pinned to retail Firefox (or Windows). See docs/retail-captures.md.

statuses.generated: a script regenerates the table from the captures named in `sources`; the committed bytes are what it writes
statuses.by-hand: typed in the code; `measurement` names the capture file that bears on it (or says it is missing); `host_needed` names the host a new capture needs
statuses.none-page: no page can read it; `produced_today` says how it is produced
statuses.pending: to be handled by the second piece (the _fpforge tables)

entries.what: Navigator identity strings: User-Agent form (version left as a placeholder), platform, oscpu, appVersion

targets.symbol: USER_AGENT, PLATFORM_OVERRIDE, OSCPU_OVERRIDE, APPVERSION_OVERRIDE (read from the file)

entries.host_needed: github-runner or Windows 11 desktop (a page reads navigator.*)

entries.what: Brand prefs of the official branding (release notes URLs, selfxss count, welcome URL)
entries.note: reads the branding pref file of the pinned engine source; chrome-only prefs

entries.what: Official brand files a page can load under chrome://branding (archive)
entries.note: regenerated from Mozilla's tree at every port; tests/test_branding_source.py fails while stale

entries.what: Three retail API keys (Safe Browsing, location, Mozilla)

produced_today.ref: read once from the retail omni.ja; no script re-reads them

entries.note: never exposed to content; used only in browser request URLs

entries.what: First-run prefs of a fresh retail profile: preonboarding, terms-of-use version and date
entries.note: measured with a probe kept outside this repository; the test ties the declared minimum version to the engine's source

entries.what: Prefs declared as retail 151 has them: field-sizing, fingerprinting protection and its overrides, cookieBehavior

measurement.covers: 159 shows field-sizing in the computed style, the 16-hex deBG chunk shape in the PNG and cookieEnabled true: consistent with the declared prefs; the pref values themselves are not page-readable

entries.note: measured on 151 (2026-08/10); no capture file of that run exists; the declared values were not re-captured on 159

entries.what: Fission defaults as retail on desktop: autostart, isolation strategy, process count
entries.note: chrome-only process prefs; the test ties the three together and reads their types from the engine source

entries.what: TLS ClientHello of retail: cipher 0xC009 not offered (JA3/JA4 form)

measurement.evidence: verified once against a public TLS fingerprint service over the internet; no local capture exists

entries.host_needed: github-runner (runner-server: a local TLS server records the ClientHello)

entries.what: HTTP request headers of retail: set, order, Accept-Language q-values

targets.symbol: _apply_hardware (network.cookie.cookieBehavior comment: header order found from the wire)

measurement.evidence: found by reading the wire against the stock build; the wrapper's e2e checks OUR header on a local socket and does not measure the retail

entries.host_needed: github-runner (runner-server: a local server records request line and header order)

entries.what: DoH default provider uri, bootstrap address, excluded domains

produced_today.ref: the uri is Firefox's default; the bootstrap address is one the provider answered with on 2026-11-11

entries.note: chrome pref; lookups go to the provider, not to a server we run

entries.what: Remote Settings server, collection ids and security-state constants
entries.note: the data is downloaded from Mozilla's service at run time and verified, never pinned; the eight constants were read from Mozilla's source

entries.what: Default language list per locale build (Accept-Languages), 95 rows

measurement.evidence: ported from Firefox's Rust source (intl/locale/rust/locale_service_glue); a retail Italian build's list was compared once on a signed 151.0; the 159 capture holds only the en-US row (navigator.languages en-US, en)

entries.host_needed: github-runner (one locale build per run; 95 builds)

entries.what: Set of 103 Firefox locale builds a persona can run

produced_today.ref: list written by hand from the builds of Firefox 151 (entries that are not a build dropped)

entries.note: a list of published builds; not readable from a page. A generator could read Mozilla's release listing

entries.what: Country to Firefox build shares, 836 pairs (a population statistic)

produced_today.ref: owner's decision 2026-10-06: updated by hand from a public data report; the product must not depend on that site at run time

entries.what: Media decode support per track mime type (declared)

measurement.covers: video/avc, hevc, vp8, vp9 and av1: supported, smooth and power efficient true, i.e. swhw: equal to the table
measurement.differs: audio/mp4a-latm: the table says `sw` (Windows decodes audio in software) but the capture reports audio.aac power efficient true, so the rule that gives swhw for the video rows gives swhw here too: the table cannot be regenerated from the capture by one rule

entries.what: Media encode support per track mime type for WebRTC (declared): software only for avc, vp8, vp9, av1
mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo table by container and codec family (10 rows)

measurement.covers: 5 of the 10 rows are covered by the capture and equal: mp4 avc1 111, mp4 hvc1 111, mp4 av01 111, webm vp09 111, webm vp8 110
measurement.differs: not probed by the capture page, so the table cannot be generated: mp4 avc3, mp4 hev1, mp4 vp09, webm av01, webm vp9 (the capture's vp9 row asks for the vp09 string). The page needs those ten content types

entries.what: Widevine answer (EME enabled), speech synthesis and VP8 hardware prefs

measurement.evidence: one requestMediaKeySystemAccess call on 2026-08-09 (retail Windows OK com.widevine.alpha); the VP8 pref was read from MediaDataCodec.cpp; neither is in the host-gate page

entries.what: WebGPU D3D12 adapter: 12 features (Firefox adds core-features-and-limits) and 35 limits

targets.symbol: reads the file, holds no copy

entries.host_needed: Windows 11 + GPU (the same for four adapter variants and five display scales in the 159 capture)

entries.what: WebGL1/2 extension lists per Windows persona
Baseline WebGL1/2 extension lists (27 and 16 names), used when no persona is applied

measurement.covers: the lists of one Intel integrated GPU on retail 159: 31 and 19 names
measurement.differs: WebGL1: the capture has 4 more (EXT_clip_control, EXT_depth_clamp, EXT_polygon_offset_clamp, EXT_texture_mirror_clamp_to_edge) and the table has none the capture lacks. WebGL2: the capture has 5 more (those four and EXT_texture_norm16) and the table has 2 the capture lacks (EXT_color_buffer_half_float, OES_texture_half_float_linear). The order differs too. The table was measured on 151 and is not changed

entries.host_needed: Windows 11 + GPU (the extension set depends on the ANGLE driver)

entries.what: WebGL numeric params per GPU model (int, int2, float, shader precisions)
entries.note: an offline extract of third-party telemetry, no extractor in the repository; MAX_VIEWS_OVR 4 was read on retail 159

entries.what: WebGL renderer and vendor strings
WebGL MSAA samples (4), ESSL version, stencil mask

measurement.covers: SAMPLES 4 and SAMPLE_BUFFERS 1 on the capture's GPU (Intel integrated); GLSL ES 1.0 and 3.00: consistent with the declared 4
measurement.differs: one GPU only; the Arc A750 parameters hash at msaa=4 quoted in the code has no capture file

entries.what: Graphics feature statuses, 20 devices x 63 features
Software compositing statuses declared for every persona (16 features)

produced_today.ref: read with nsIGfxInfo.getFeatureStatusStr on a GitHub windows-2022 runner (adapter Microsoft Hyper-V Video); no script in this repository

entries.note: nsIGfxInfo is chrome-only; owner's decision 2026-11-15; tests/test_software_compositing_is_declared.py ties the table to the engine's names

entries.what: Window frame per display scale (border, maximized and popup chrome, popup position) and taskbar height

measurement.evidence: measured on retail 151 on 2026-10-08 with a workbench script outside this repository; a 2026-11-20 run on 160.0.1 at one scale (1.7647) exists outside this repository. The 159 captures cannot decide it: their window is not maximized (screenX 2 to 4, -6 at 2x)

entries.host_needed: Windows 11 desktop at display scales 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2 (set by hand in the OS), window maximized
